release_name: Factory Structural DED Standard (ISO A3 Bottom-Strip) & SheetManager Upgrade
highlights: Official Factory Structural DED Skill (revit-factory-structural-ded): Codified ISO A3 Landscape bottom-strip titleblock geometry (420x297 mm, 38 mm bottom strip, 394x253 mm canvas), 8-series sheet taxonomy (000, DG, SD, DT, PT, PD, LT, RF), and 5 standard composition templates (including Hybrid 2D + 3D Shaded Isometric)

Machine-Readable DED Standard Schema (factory_structural_ded_standard.json) & AGENTS.md Section 12: Permanent drafting rules for Typical Portal Grouping, >150m partial plan splits with Keyplans, ISO metric scale ladder, and 8 anti-error QA guardrails learned from NUAS-FT-BU-ST.rvt

SheetManager ISO A3 Bottom-Strip & Stamp Keep-Out Engine (SheetManagerSkill.cs): Automatic bottom-strip titleblock orientation detection, 48x18 mm bottom-right status stamp keep-out protection, titleblock_layout override, and bottom-bar ASCII paper-space map
fixes: Prevented SheetManager viewport placement from overlapping bottom-strip A3 titleblocks and bottom-right FOR TENDER / FOR CONSTRUCTION status stamps

Encoded 8 QA anti-pattern guardrails (short Detail Numbers <=4 chars, zero wrong cross-ref bubbles on independent plans, naming hygiene regex blocklist, NO. parameter sync before export, and >50-sheet bridge pagination)
